description: Shared experiment evaluation cases. Each case is a config (experiments and holdouts), the units and attributes of one read, and what a reader serves for each experiment. `expect` holds under both policies; `expectFailClosed` replaces entries for a reader that fails closed. `expectHoldouts` lists every holdout resolved for the units, with the experiments the read is an exposure for, sorted; absent means none resolve.
